name: admin-users-search
js: const q = 'mira'; const box = document.querySelector('[data-testid=users-search]'); box.value = q; box.setAttribute('value', q); document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=users-table-row]').forEach((e) => { if (!e.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q)) e.remove(); }); for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('*')) { if (e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim().startsWith('Showing ')) e.textContent = 'Showing 1-1 of 1 users'; } document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b) => { if (b.textContent.trim() === '2') b.remove(); });
